firstPlayerRule: The player seated closest to a solid doorframe goes first.
houseFallback: If the nearest seat is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Turns then proceed clockwise. Each turn draws and places a tile, with an optional road crew placement if allowed.
The rule awarding a tie to the tallest player concerns the final score, not the choice of starting player.
